dogecoin.text: Dogecoin price rose to an all-time high of nearly 75 cents after Tesla CEO Elon Musk posted a promotional image of his SNL appearance. The picture showed Musk posing alongside two other SNL guest stars, with Dogecoin's mascot, a Shibu Ina, photoshopped in.

Billionaire investor Mark Cuban said he believes cryptocurrencies are a more environmentally friendly way to store wealth than gold. He added that his basketball team, Dallas Mavericks, would continue accepting Bitcoin, Dogecoin and Ether payments for tickets and merchandise.
